purpose: Kikai brand override for the visual-aware base format. The base fixes layout slot positions; this file fixes Kikai brand behavior and prompt composition.

image2_card_media.brandInstruction: Generate one distinct image per card slot. Keep the image borderless because the HTML card owns the 3pt frame.

svg_diagram.brandInstruction: Use dark gray monoline structure with #FC754A route markers. SVG must explain flow, branch, loop, gate, comparison, or risk.

photo_or_screenshot.brandInstruction: Use supplied real assets first. Do not recreate real people, logos, or products with generated imagery.

none.brandInstruction: Do not fill whitespace with decoration. Increase density through editable text, comments, labels, rows, or metrics.
